title: Google Research Psycholab: ASCII Multi-Agent Gridworld Games, Conflict Resolution & RGB Visualizer
author: repo-triad-forge

edges.description: Subproject psycholab in snapshot google-research-master (archive snapshot, non-git); arXiv:1906.09831
Complements visual RL wrappers with ASCII-specified multi-agent gridworld RGB/discrete environments
Multi-agent coordination and repeated-game conflict modeling relevant to multi-agent consensus

claims.assertion: Game.solve_conflicts enforces wall/item stops, head-on player crossing cancellations, standing-player blocks, and random draw tie-breaking (<player>_lost_the_drawn) for simultaneous target-cell collisions, emitting structured event lists that drive reward_events, apply_effects, terminal_step, and RGB render (uint8 HxWx3 map).
Visualizer wraps any Game environment to render live two-pane RGB grid maps and per-player plus mean cumulative reward trajectories with optional FFMpegWriter MP4 video capture.

distilled_learning: Model multi-agent social dilemmas declaratively from ASCII grid layouts with explicit multi-pass conflict resolution (walls, head-on swaps, standing blocks, randomized cell ties) and structured event-driven rewards and RGB visual diagnostics.
